testXpert testing software
Simple, flexible, future proof and reliable – the leading software solution for materials testing
Our testXpert testing software is the leading software solution in materials testing. testXpert features simple operation, flexible process integration and a future-proof design. This guarantees reliable and efficient testing. Whether for static or dynamic test methods, for testing machines or instruments: testXpert always provides the right solution.

Start testing right away thanks to minimal training requirement
With testXpert you can quickly train your employees and start testing right away. Operation is very simple and intuitive, the user interface is clearly laid out and the machine is already configured. And that along with maximum protection for both the user and the testing system. Materials testing made simple!

Efficient data management with testXpert Analytics
With testXpert Analytics you are always one step ahead. Centralized real-time machine and test data and various other tools provide the support you need to increase testing efficiency: 
Predictive monitoring: The Condition Monitoring feature provides a single view of all your machine data, as well as upcoming maintenance and calibration requirements. 
Smart analysis: All test results are centrally stored and can therefore be extensively evaluated via our Test Data Management feature, while Trend Analysis offers longterm evaluation of individual test data. In addition, Fatigue Data Evaluation delivers S-N curves with a single click.

testXpert testing software FAQs
 Can I use testXpert on any materials testing machine?
testXpert primarily runs on ZwickRoell machines. But you can also use testXpert with testing machines from other manufacturers. The requirement for this is to retrofit the machine with our testControl measurement and control electronics.
 What does the testXpert license model look like?
testXpert is offered with an unlimited license agreement. The basic version of the software is free and can be used by an unlimited number of users.
 What are the hardware requirements?
testXpert runs on current Windows PCs with Windows 10 or 11. testXpert is also optimized for operation via touch screen.
 Do I have to configure the parameters myself?
We offer over 800 pre-configured standard test programs in which all relevant parameters have already been set. This guarantees 100% standard-compliant testing and saves time. All you have to do is enter the specimen dimensions. 
You also have the option to configure any test sequence yourself.
 Do I need training for testXpert?
Operating testXpert is fundamentally intuitive and no special training is required for the basic functions. We do, however, recommend a brief instructional session by one of our service engineers within the scope of commissioning.
 Does the software alert me in case of possible application errors or incorrect settings?
testXpert offers a plausibility check option that can be customized to your application. With this, you avoid incorrect entries or incorrect parameterization. 
Furthermore, testXpert includes an intelligent, context sensitive help function.
 In what languages is testXpert available?
testXpert is available in more than eleven languages. The user can choose the correct language online with a simple click. You also have the option to operate testXpert in one language and print out the test report in another.
 How do I protect my information from being manipulated?
testXpert includes a comprehensive user and rights management feature that allows you to specify which user has access to which data. For industries with special data integrity requirements, such as the medical industry, testXpert offers an advanced traceability function with digital signature.
 How can I import/export data?
One standard feature included in testXpert is the import of organization data and export of all data. The import function includes the integration of external measurement signals, external devices and a direct data connection to host systems. With the Export Editor, all test and organization data as well as raw data can be exported directly to Excel, Word, PDF and proprietary company (database) systems.
 How does testXpert react to possible Windows updates?
testXpert is continuously developed and tested based on current Windows versions. You can update your system any time and continue using your test programs.

Testing software for dynamic applications
testXpert R is the right test software for fatigue tests and cyclic materials and components testing. It is used for all ZwickRoell dynamic testing systems. 
The materials testing software offers the right test programs for fracture mechanics, low cycle fatigue (LCF) and free test definitions.
